agent04_report.reasoning: Source-only inspection of panel.png established a 173–695 px by 60–512 px linear plot frame, Pressure [kPa] on x, CO2 Loading [mmol/g] on y, and six legend-bound CO2 temperature series. Native legend evidence fixes the styles as filled red circle, orange square, green triangle_up, blue pentagon, magenta diamond, and black star; there are no excluded gas series or inset/mask regions. Independent tick fits used x anchors (173,0), (347,40), (521,80), (695,120) and y anchors (512,0), (437,0.5), (362,1), (286,1.5), (211,2), (135,2.5), (60,3). After that source pass, the complete Agent 03 table and review_tiles.json inventory were audited against tile_01_native.png (boxes 1–8), tile_02_native.png (boxes 9–16), tile_03_native.png (boxes 17–20), region_01_native.png, region_02_native.png, and the unchanged panel. The native tiles confirm that the disputed low-pressure red/green positions are continuous-band ink rather than separable glyphs. Eight green direct/template claims were therefore deleted, while source-backed dense-band samples were retained. Agent 03 also mislabeled low-pressure black line coordinates as visible markers; those coordinates were retained but corrected to review-only line_sample evidence. The major omitted feature was a fused pair near x≈607–616 px in every series: two same-series glyph lobes are visible in panel.png, whereas Agent 03 stored one aggregate centroid. Each aggregate row was moved to the left partial centre and one right partial centre was added. Four red and one green native trace samples were added to close over-wide gaps. All saved x/y values were recomputed from the final calibration, the CSV was reloaded, and a reconstruction/overlay made only from the reloaded CSV was inspected. Coverage remains uncertain in the red, green, and black low-pressure strips because continuous ink supports traces but not a count or centres of wholly hidden markers; no estimated_marker rows were fabricated.

visual_risks: Thick, overlapping low-pressure red, green, and black bands hide individual glyph boundaries.
At native x≈607–616 px each series has two strongly overlapping same-series markers that automated connected-component methods merge.
The orange 313K markers overlap red/green bands at low pressure but retain square edges.
Raster antialiasing and dark outlines shift color-only centroids away from geometric glyph centres.
The in-plot legend covers lower-right data space, but no eligible curve enters the legend rectangle.

series.label: CO2 303K
series.comment: 15 direct/partial circle rows and 30 low-pressure line samples. The native red strip spans about (174,455) to (290,177) px; four trace samples were added in the former 56 px gap. Maximum saved along-band spacing is about 15.0 px. Individual hidden circles within the strip remain unresolved.

series.label: CO2 313K
series.comment: 19 direct/partial square rows. Native squares are separable across the plotted range; the fused high-pressure component was split into two partial square centres.

series.label: CO2 323K
series.comment: 15 direct/partial triangle rows and 29 line samples. Eight Agent 03 marker/template claims inside the fused green strip were deleted because the native tiles show band ink or overlap but no separate triangle. One trace sample closed the only >14 px internal gap; maximum saved trace spacing is about 11.4 px. Hidden strip markers remain unresolved.

series.label: CO2 333K
series.comment: 20 direct/partial pentagon rows. Native pentagons are separable, including two overlapping high-pressure glyphs recovered as separate partial centres.

series.label: CO2 353K
series.comment: 19 direct/partial diamond rows. Native diamonds are separable, including two overlapping high-pressure glyphs recovered as separate partial centres.

series.label: CO2 373K
series.comment: 14 direct/partial star rows and 12 low-pressure line samples. The first 12 Agent 03 rows were reclassified from visible markers to line samples because panel.png shows only a thick continuous black band there. The trace spacing is at most about 16.9 px and reaches within about 14 px of the band endpoint; hidden stars remain unresolved.

uncertainties: No estimated_marker rows were used. All inferred rows are native line_sample coordinates and therefore keep the result under review.
The six fused high-pressure pairs are represented by supported partial-glyph centres with approximately 2.5 px positional uncertainty; their two-lobe contours are visible but overlap strongly.
Red, green, and black low-pressure strips are sampled only where same-series native ink is present. Their hidden experimental marker count is not inferred.
The final linear y fit has 0.277 px RMS and 0.464 px maximum anchor reprojection error from rasterized tick-centre selection.
There are no source masks or insets; the legend rectangle was excluded from marker search.

x.note: Accepted the centers of the bottom/top major tick strokes. No x anchor was excluded.

y.note: Accepted the centers of the left/right major tick strokes. No y anchor was excluded; subpixel residuals reflect rasterized stroke widths.
